title: The anti-rug detail dialog tells the wrong story: any position that is not "exit-fired" or "would-have-sold" (which after AUD-DASH-001 is nearly all) opens the "Exit pending confirmation: the bot has detected a confirmed rug signal" variant, and the live variant never receives the transaction details it says are shown

evidence.note: variant = 'live' for exit-fired, 'dry-run' for would-have-sold, otherwise 'pending-confirm' (including live, dry-run, halted, unmonitored and missing state)
pending-confirm text: "Exit pending confirmation. The bot has detected a confirmed rug signal and will submit the exit transaction after ? blocks"
the modal gets variant, token prefix, chain, signals and success only: no txHash, block, amounts or explorer link
success banner: "see the tx artifacts below for the receipt"
the tx block renders only when txHash is set, which it never is
every badge, whatever its state, opens the dialog

sibling_sites_checked: Both openers of the dialog (PositionTable badge click via Overview.tsx:167-169; AntiRugMonitorTile event click via Overview.tsx:225-237, which matches the position by token and opens it with that position's current state, not the event's); all three variants and their inputs (AntiRugExitDetailModal.tsx:131-222). The token is shown as an address prefix labelled tokenSymbol (Overview.tsx:276). No other dialog in the dashboard derives its message from a fallback state.
severity_rationale: S3: misleading operator text. Clicking the badge of a quiet position states that a confirmed rug was detected and an exit is about to be submitted; an operator who believes an exit is pending may wait instead of acting, or act on a rug that did not happen. No money path changes.
recommendation: Map each monitor state to its own dialog text (no rug-detected wording for live, dry-run, halted or unmonitored), and pass the exit transaction details through the state update or drop the claim that they are shown. Phase 29.
